sovereign_country.strategic_role: 苏伊士运河经济特区、辐射中东及北非的低成本轻工制造

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Visual Web Template and Low-Code Web Application Builder

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Islamic Sharia as a principal source of legislation under Article 2 of the 2014 Constitution)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Egypt-United States BIT (1992) and US-Egypt Double Taxation Treaty (1981)
Egypt-United Kingdom BIT (1975) and Egypt-UK Double Taxation Arrangement (1980)
COMESA, Greater Arab Free Trade Area (GAFTA), and Egypt-EU Association Agreement (2004)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing, as amended by Law No. 36 of 2014 and Law No. 8 of 2023; Executive Regulations issued by Prime Ministerial Decree No. 95 of 2020 (as amended); Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 as amended by Law No. 148 of 2019 (mandatory Register of Beneficial Owners submitted to the Commercial Registry/GAFI); Law No. 8 of 2015 on Combating Terrorism (national designation lists); Central Bank of Egypt AML/CFT Rulebook and Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) implementing decisions for non-bank entities; obligations of Designated Non-Financial Businesses and Professions (DNFBPs), including lawyers and company formation agents, under the EMLCU regime.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized, notarially certified copy of the passport (or national ID) of each foreign shareholder and natural-person beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the shareholder's country of origin or residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Hague Apostille is NOT accepted; Egypt is not a Contracting State to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / corporate extract of any foreign corporate shareholder (latest issue date)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry or company regulator of the home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the origin country and the competent Egyptian Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney in Arabic (or bilingual) appointing the Egyptian formation counsel and resident commercial agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Egyptian Notary Public after signing before the Egyptian Consulate or a notary abroad
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization, then Ministry of Justice (Egypt) attestation of signatory capacity

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Arabic legal translation of all foreign-language corporate documents, executed by an accredited translator before the Egyptian Ministry of Justice
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Egyptian Ministry of Justice accredited translator / Translation Department
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization of the translator's signature with Egyptian Consular attestation where executed abroad

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory CDD/EDD in accordance with Law No. 80/2002 and FATF Recommendations 10-12: (i) identify all shareholders, directors and UBOs at the 25% threshold; (ii) screen against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, US OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Egypt's national terrorist designation lists under Law No. 8/2015 and EMLCU circulars; (iii) treat foreign PEPs, domestic PEPs, PEPs of international organizations and their family/close associates as high-risk, apply enhanced due diligence, senior management approval and source-of-wealth/source-of-funds documentation; (iv) report any match or suspicious transaction to the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU) and obtain regulatory clearance before proceeding where a match is confirmed.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) 'Invest in Egypt' integrated one-stop-shop (https://investinegypt.gov.eg) and the national Commercial Registry ('Tjary') electronic platform of the Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory corporate name must be in Modern Standard Arabic; a Latin (English) transliteration of the Arabic registered name is recorded as the foreign spelling and may be used in international contracts. A name consisting only of Latin characters is NOT registrable. For an LLC, the Arabic name must be followed by the descriptor 'LLC' / 'ذات مسئولية محدودة'.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Insurance, Reinsurance, Deposit, Fund, Finance, Securities, Clearing (require prior CBE or FRA licensing)
Central, National, Sovereign, Presidential, Government, Ministry, Military, Police, Public Authority (imply state affiliation and require ministerial approval)
Arab Republic of Egypt, Egyptian, International, Global, Holding, Free Zone (require proof of multi-country operations, group structure, or special authorization)
Sacred religious or Quranic names, names of foreign states' institutions, royal or national symbols of foreign states, and third-party trademarks
Deceptive or contradictory names likely to cause confusion with an existing registered Egyptian company
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, obtain a written note of the grounds from GAFI/Commercial Registry; re-file with an alternative distinguishable Arabic name or, where the objection is substantive, submit a formal grievance letter to the GAFI one-stop-shop legal committee within 30 days of rejection; if the administrative grievance fails, appeal to the Egyptian State Council (Administrative Court) within the 60-day statutory limitation period. The 90-day reservation may be administratively renewed once for a further 90 days by presenting the original clearance to the Commercial Registry and paying a small renewal stamp duty before expiry.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the sole statutory seat. Under Law 159/1981 and GAFI practice, an LLC must maintain a physical and substantive office in Egypt evidenced by a notarized lease agreement, municipal address, and name plate. A managed business-center suite with a dedicated desk, meeting room access and a valid lease is conditionally acceptable for a low-risk software/IT entity; pure mailbox, virtual-office or P.O. Box addresses are rejected by the Commercial Registry and the Tax Authority.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low risk: an estimated 5-10% cumulative annual probability of unannounced inspection. A single physical verification may be conducted at the time of incorporation when the lease is notarized and the Tax Card (TIN) is issued; thereafter the Commercial Registry conducts visits mainly upon third-party complaints, and the Tax Authority may inspect for e-invoicing and VAT purposes intermittently.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search, clearance and reservation in the Commercial Registry/GAFI one-stop-shop system
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule of the General Authority for Investment

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: GAFI investment and incorporation services tariff (Invest in Egypt platform)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of the Arabic Articles of Association (MOA/AOA) and board resolutions before an Egyptian Notary Public
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Justice – Notary Public Dept.
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notary Public Law No. 68/1947 statutory stamp and gratuit fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial Registry ('Tjary') final registration of the LLC and issuance of the commercial register extract
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade – Commercial Registry

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the incorporation notice in the Official Gazette (Al-Waqa'i' Al-Misriyya)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian Official Gazette – State Information Service
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Publication tariff per page/notice published in the Gazette

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-filing of the Register of Beneficial Owners (UBO register) with GAFI/Commercial Registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: UBO register filing tariff under Law 148/2019 executive regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Tax registration: issuance of Tax Card (TIN), VAT registration and e-invoicing activation for the IT services scope
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: ETA service and stamp fee schedule for tax card issuance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, EU and Egyptian national sanctions screening plus AML/CFT client due diligence file compilation (formation counsel)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a standard low-risk technology entity (stage 1 DNFBP compliance)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Arabic-English translation of foreign corporate documents and consular legalization/courier handling
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Accredited translation office, Egyptian Consulate and Egyptian MFA attestation units
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Ministry of Justice translator tariffs and Egyptian consular fees (per-document)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company seal stamping, certified Arabic copies and ancillary administrative authentication batch
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: GAFI service center / Commercial Registry stamp office

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended by Law No. 4 of 2009, together with its Executive Regulations; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 implementing the GAFI one-stop-shop procedure; Articles 20, 21, 33, 35 and 36 of Law No. 159/1981 addressing LLC formation, share capital, incorporation contract and management; Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - One-Stop Shop / Investor Services Center, Cairo; Commercial Registry Office of the Ministry of Trade and Industry; Egyptian Tax Authority for fiscal registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Incorporation Contract and Articles of Association (Aqd Al-Taasis wa Al-Nizam Al-Asasi) filed electronically through the GAFI investor portal (Egyptiantech system).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: LLC minimum share capital of EGP 50,000 (approximately USD 1,600). The full subscribed capital must be deposited into a temporary escrow bank account with a GAFI-designated Egyptian bank before incorporation, and the escrow deposit certificate must be attached to the registration dossier. The deposited funds are released to the LLC operating account immediately after issuance of the Commercial Registration Certificate. Payment of subscribed capital may be phased in installments over up to five years only if the incorporation contract expressly so provides, but the total EGP 50,000 deposit remains a precondition for GAFI clearance.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Incorporated Agreement and Articles of Association, as filed with the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones, are approved in final form; and that the founding partners subscribe to the entire share capital of EGP 50,000 per the subscription schedule and deposit it in the designated escrow account at a licensed Egyptian bank. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office be fixed at 15 Tahrir Street, Cairo, Egypt, where statutory records shall be kept. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] be appointed General Manager and [Name] Compliance Officer, with authority to sign incorporation submissions, open the operating account, and complete all post-incorporation tax and VAT registrations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop / electronic investor portal (Egyptiantech system), Cairo Headquarters
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the GAFI investor portal, complete the name reservation form with three alternative company names in Arabic and transliterated English, and pay the reservation fee electronically. GAFI automatically screens the proposed names against the commercial-registry index and reserved-name databases. After approval, download the name reservation certificate which remains valid for 60 days.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form
Copy of passport or national ID of each founding partner
Preferred and alternative company names in Arabic and English
Electronic payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or public-order grounds, re-submit with three new alternatives directly in the portal; the rejection reasoning is displayed and can be cured the same business day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Incorporation Contract and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Office / Real Estate Registry Office (Al-Shahr Al-Aqari) at the governorate where the registered office is located
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed Egyptian attorney to draft the Arabic incorporation contract containing the LLC name, purpose (digital software publishing and no-code platform development), share capital of EGP 50,000, share allocation, registered-office address, and manager appointment. All founding partners or their notarized attorneys-in-fact must appear before the notary to sign the contract. The notary records the contract in the official notarial register and issues certified copies.
required_dossiers: Draft incorporation contract in Arabic
Name reservation certificate
Valid passport or national ID of each founding partner
Notarized power of attorney if any partner is represented
Lease contract or title deed for the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies drafting defects, correct the draft and re-notarize; the notary's comments are definitive and no GAFI re-submission is required for the correction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Escrow Capital Deposit and Bank Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI-designated Egyptian bank (e.g., National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr, Commercial International Bank) - corporate account opening unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary escrow account in the name of the LLC under formation, deposit the subscribed capital of EGP 50,000, and obtain the provisional deposit certificate. The certificate must state the account holder name, deposit amount, date and purpose. The funds remain blocked until the Commercial Registration Certificate is issued, at which point they are released to the operational current account of the LLC.
required_dossiers: Notarized incorporation contract
Name reservation certificate
Passport or national ID of the authorized manager
Bank KYC forms and source-of-funds declaration
Deposit slip for EGP 50,000
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced due diligence, provide a source-of-funds declaration or transfer the deposit to another GAFI-designated bank the same day; all designated banks apply the anti-money-laundering standards of Law No. 80 of 2002.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop (Investor Services Center), Cairo headquarters or governorate branch
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete incorporation dossier online via the GAFI portal (Egyptiantech) or physically at the One-Stop Shop: scanned notarized incorporation contract, bank escrow deposit certificate, name reservation, registered-office lease, and partner identity documents. Pay the official incorporation fee, commercial-registry fee, and publication fee in a single electronic payment. GAFI performs the substantive legal review and issues the incorporation decision, which is automatically forwarded to the Commercial Registry and the Egyptian Tax Authority.
required_dossiers: Notarized incorporation contract and articles of association
Bank escrow deposit certificate
Name reservation certificate
Registered office lease contract (stamped with the tax authority)
Passport copies of all founding partners
General Manager declaration of acceptance
Power of attorney if the filing is made through an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI issues a query notice, file a written response with curing documents at the One-Stop Shop within the statutory period; any amendment to the contract must first be re-notarized. Under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017, GAFI failure to decide within 10 working days of a complete dossier triggers the automatic-approval rule.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registration, Tax Card and VAT Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry Office of the Ministry of Trade and Industry; Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) and its electronic service portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the GAFI incorporation decision, obtain the Commercial Registration Certificate (Al-Sijil Al-Tijari) from the Commercial Registry. Thereafter obtain the Tax Card (estimated fiscal number) from the ETA district office and complete VAT registration through the ETA online filing system where the digital services meet the registration threshold or the company elects voluntary registration. Present the original Tax Card at the registered office address.
required_dossiers: GAFI incorporation decision
Commercial registration application form
Office lease contract and utility bill or smart meter statement
Passport or national ID copies of partners
Tax card application form (Estithara)
VAT registration form where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any objection to the tax-card issuance must be filed in writing at the competent ETA district office; minor data corrections in the Commercial Registry are processed within one working day upon production of the notarized incorporation contract.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Official Gazette Publication and Social Insurance Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI publication department with Al-Waqa'i Al-Misriya (Official Gazette); National Social Insurance Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: GAFI automatically transmits the incorporation notice to the Official Gazette after the Commercial Registration is complete; publication is constitutive for reliance against third parties. The General Manager then registers the company and any employees with the National Social Insurance Authority if staff are hired, and obtains the insurance registration certificate.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration Certificate
Tax Card
General Manager national ID or passport
Employee list and payroll schedule if any
Publication fee receipt if paid separately
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Gazette publication is delayed, request a publication certificate from GAFI and follow up directly with the Gazette office; if social-insurance registration misses the statutory deadline, file the late-registration declaration and pay the nominal late-administrative fee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - software publishing and no-code/low-code platform development (ISIC 6201, NAICS 511210) is not an industrial establishment under Industrial Licensing Law No. 15 of 2017 Annex 1; no Industrial Operations License or factory registration is required.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required for the digital service activity; the Commercial Registration Certificate and Tax Card constitute the lawful authorization to carry on business. If the company later installs physical server infrastructure or a data center in Egypt, a separate telecommunications/data-center authorization from the National Telecommunications Regulatory Authority (NTRA) would be assessed at that time.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) - Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category 4 (Administrative and low-impact service activities). Office-based software operations with no manufacturing discharge do not require an Environmental Impact Assessment under Law No. 4 of 1994, as amended by Law No. 9 of 2009; a voluntary environmental registration may be filed where a landlord or building authority requests it.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to office operations: no industrial wastewater, VOC or particulate emissions are generated. Where applicable, domestic sewage must comply with Law No. 93 of 1962, and general solid waste must be disposed of through municipality-approved contractors in accordance with Waste Management Law No. 202 of 2020. Any uninterruptible power supply batteries must be recycled through EEAA-licensed waste handlers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate (Civil Defense approval) from the General Administration of Civil Defense is required before occupying the registered office; where the office is within a multi-tenant building, the landlord's existing building fire-safety approval may be relied upon. Occupational workplace clearance under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003 requires basic health-and-safety documentation, worker insurance coverage and compliance with office occupancy limits; structural-load inspection is not required for standard office occupancy and becomes relevant only for special-load equipment such as heavy server racks, for which a structural assessment must be submitted to the local municipality.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) under the Ministry of Finance, operating the unified TAXA digital portal at https://www.incometax.gov.eg and the VAT/e-invoicing platform at https://www.eta.gov.eg.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned LLC must first obtain a Commercial Registration (Sijil Tijari) and legal incorporation certificate from the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI). The LLC must then: (1) register with the ETA to obtain a Tax Card (Karteh El-Daribeh) by filing the registration application, incorporation contracts, certified passport copies, and lease/power-of-attorney documents at the competent tax office; (2) obtain a separate Value Added Tax (VAT) registration certificate under VAT Law No. 67/2016; (3) enroll in the ETA e-invoicing system as mandated; (4) appoint a tax & fiscal domicile addressing in Egypt. Non-resident digital businesses without a fixed establishment register only for VAT via an Egyptian fiscal representative, whereas the Egyptian LLC - as a resident entity - registers under both income tax and VAT automatically.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; Territorial_Scope (resident LLC taxed on worldwide income; foreign shareholders taxed only on Egyptian-source items); Tax_Exempt_Zone opportunities inside SCZONE/GAFI-registered projects are conditional and not presumed for a standard Cairo-registered LLC.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid entity election exists under Egyptian tax law. Elective mechanisms include: (1) VAT simplified registration election under Article 21 of Law 67/2016 for turnover between EGP 350,000 and EGP 500,000; (2) election to apply the standard VAT refund route for exporters; (3) appointment of a fiscal representative election for VAT-free-zone / non-resident scenarios; (4) advance pricing agreement election for cross-border related-party service charges; (5) selection of tax amortization/depreciation tables under Income Tax Law 91/2005. All elections require ETA approval and written notification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax, Law No. 67 of 2016, as amended by Law No. 3 of 2023)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory VAT registration applies when annual taxable supplies exceed EGP 500,000; a simplified registration band exists at EGP 350,000-500,000. Non-resident suppliers of cross-border digital services are registrable without any threshold (reverse charge applies).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egypt operates a real-time mandatory e-invoicing clearance system (e-Invoice, launched November 2020). Registered taxpayers must integrate with ETA REST APIs, submit simplified tax invoices in a validated XML format to ETA for approval before sending to customers, and include a generated QR barcode with digital signature (XAdES-BES). Phased mandatory committees apply; any LLC scaled to the target turnover should already have API access. E-receipts are separately mandatory for B2C transactions. Failure to clear invoices disallows input VAT credit and triggers penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A zero percent VAT rate applies to (1) exported goods physically leaving Egypt; (2) exported services rendered to non-resident persons where the service is used/exploited outside Egypt, including computer programming and remote software/SaaS services; and (3) supplies to free zones under special schemes. The zero-rating claim requires an official request to ETA with a service contract, export document, and proof of payment received in transferable foreign currency. Non-resident payment rails (Stripe/Paddle) must be evidenced by bank statements and inward remittance vouchers.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD - Single Administrative Document) for physical exports
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing export
Inward Remittance Certificate and bank confirmation of FX inflow
Export contract / service agreement with customer name and country
ETA-approved tax invoice matched to e-invoice clearing record
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ETA audits zero-rating claims retroactively for up to 5 years. Penalties include a fine of not less than 200% and not exceeding 300% of the evaded tax, plus payment of the due tax itself under Article 66 of Law 67/2016; imprisonment for responsible managers for fraudulent documentation; withdrawal of zero-rating approval; interest at the statutory monthly rate (CBE discount rate plus 2%) from the due date; and mandatory re-issuance of invoices at 14% VAT where export documentation is incomplete.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), acting under the Central Bank and Banking System Law No. 194 of 2020, is the sole foreign exchange authority. The General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) jointly administers foreign direct investment registration, capital repatriation attestations, and the FDI database used by banks for profit remittance verification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Following the March 2024 unified exchange-rate decision, the EGP operates as a managed-float currency. Current-account transactions, including software export proceeds, SaaS subscription income, and dividends declared from audited post-tax profits, are freely convertible and remittable through CBE-licensed banks without prior approval. Capital-account items remain administratively controlled: inbound equity contributions to an Egyptian LLC are unrestricted, but outward capital repatriation, liquidation proceeds, and cross-border shareholder loans require a GAFI-registered investment file, audited financial statements, a tax clearance certificate, and the receiving bank's confirmation that the foreign currency was sourced through the interbank market. The Egyptian pound remains non-deliverable offshore, and no parallel-market legalization exists; all transactions must clear through licensed banks at the published market rate.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Statutory timeline: proceeds from exports of IT services and digital software must be collected in full within 6 months from the date of the invoice or customs declaration and must be credited into a CBE-licensed bank account in Egypt; any default requires a documented force-majeure or bank-authorized extension. Mandatory conversion ratio: 0 percent - all mandatory surrender requirements were abolished on 6 March 2024. The LLC may retain 100 percent of its USD software-export receipts in foreign-currency accounts and deploy them directly for offshore disbursements, converting only the EGP operating-cost base through the interbank market.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Current Account (EGP) + Foreign-Currency USD Export Proceeds Account
Operational Current Account (EGP) + USD Collection and Settlement Account
FDI Subscribed-Capital Account + USD Treasury Clearing Account; preferred for FX forward lines and corporate card processing
USD Trade and Liquidity Clearing Account (restricted to documented trade flows)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-to-Medium. Offshore e-money institutions (Wise, Airwallex, Revolut Business, and Stripe Treasury-style programs) hold no CBE banking license and cannot serve as the primary settlement rail for an Egyptian LLC; the CBE requires all EGP-denominated clearing, FDI registration, and profit remittance to pass through a licensed local bank. EMIs are nonetheless viable as a secondary collection and payout sub-ledger for USD subscription billing only where the LLC maintains a direct CBE-bank account as the settlement anchor. For this no-code builder, the most compliant structure uses Paddle as a merchant of record (card payments collected abroad, net proceeds remitted via MT103 into the Egyptian bank) and treats Stripe Billing as an international collection layer that requires a non-Egyptian merchant entity or a licensed Egyptian PSP partner; direct Stripe payout into Egypt is not available because Stripe does not hold a CBE payment-service-provider license.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical in-branch presence is mandatory. At least one authorized director or the designated general manager holding a CBE-compliant board resolution must attend the account-activation interview for biometric verification and e-signature enrollment; remote or fully digital corporate onboarding is not accepted by Egyptian banks. A foreign director may delegate signing authority through a notarized and apostilled power of attorney legalized by the Egyptian consulate, but the designated signatory must still appear in person for the KYC interview. The LLC must also produce its commercial registration certificate, tax card, and GAFI investment file before account activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume inbound card and recurring-billing inflows from Stripe/Paddle net settlements with no physical bill of lading, which banks may classify as aggregated or unverifiable trade receivables.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: PSP merchant contracts and monthly settlement statements; API-generated subscription sub-ledger; website Terms of Service and end-user license agreement; hosting invoices from AWS/GCP matching traffic levels; board resolution appointing the treasury officer; and audited financial statements for the first operating cycle.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership ambiguity triggered by wholly non-resident shareholders resident in GCC jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Updated UBO register filed with GAFI and the Commercial Registry; notarized shareholders' declarations; passport copies; AML self-certification forms; CRS self-certification proving tax residency; and a source-of-wealth statement backed by foreign bank statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mixed-purpose account usage where the same account receives software-export revenue and related-party management fees, which banks may reclassify as unlicensed intercompany financing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Arm's-length intercompany agreements; transfer-pricing documentation; CBE purpose-code mapping distinguishing services revenue from intercompany flows; and the GAFI FDI file evidencing the equity versus current-account split.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and negative-news screening triggered by end-users in restricted jurisdictions using the low-code platform.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Geoblocking configuration logs; automated sanctions-blocklist screening report from the platform's KYC layer; the PSP's OFAC-compliant card-blocking confirmation; IP source-data access logs; and a written certification that no sanctioned jurisdiction receives settlement proceeds.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity inflow executes via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 from the foreign shareholder's bank into the LLC's USD account at CIB or NBE, quoting the beneficiary's CBE-assigned FDI code and purpose code 'Equity Participation (Foreign Direct Investment)'. The credit advice must match the LLC's exact commercial registry name; the bank retains the GAFI investment-registration extract, the board resolution adopting the contribution, and the auditor's capital-verification letter. The receipt is reported by the bank in the monthly CBE 'Statement of Foreign Transactions' and does not trigger CRS reporting, but the LLC must record the inflow in its internal FDI ledger to support future profit repatriation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound USD disbursements for cloud hosting, software licenses, marketing, and subcontractor fees route via SWIFT MT103 for single payments or MT101 for batch processing, using CBE service-import purpose codes for software royalties, marketing, or professional services. Each disbursement requires a proforma invoice, proof of actual service delivery, and evidence of withholding-tax compliance on the service payment. For larger build-and-operate components, an irrevocable commercial letter of credit at sight or 90 days may be issued by the Egyptian bank. Inbound settlement from Paddle and Stripe is cleared as net subscription revenue through correspondent banks into the LLC's foreign-currency account, with Paddle acting as merchant of record and remitting the net amount via MT103 supported by its merchant settlement report.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/EGP deliverable foreign-exchange forwards (tenor up to 12 months) offered by CBE-licensed banks to hedge EGP operating costs and dividend provisions, requiring an underlying commercial exposure and a signed ISDA-style master agreement with the corporate banking desk.

USD/EGP non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executed with offshore counterparties to hedge residual EGP currency risk of the foreign parent, settled in USD only and permitted where the Egyptian bank confirms the absence of a deliverable market for the specific tenor.

USD/EGP cross-currency interest-rate swap for tenors of 1 to 2 years, available through the Egyptian dealing room only where the LLC holds both an EGP borrowing facility and a USD revenue stream, and structured strictly as a hedge with no speculative component.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements and directors' report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment (GAFI) – Companies Registration Department; copy to the Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the fiscal year-end (by June 30 for a calendar-year LLC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers GAFI warning and an administrative fine of EGP 500–5,000; continued non-compliance for 90 days after notice may result in administrative strike-off and cancellation of commercial registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return (forming part of the annual tax compliance package)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months from the fiscal year-end (by April 30 for a calendar-year LLC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of EGP 500–2,000; overdue tax accrues monthly delayed interest of 2% of the unpaid tax; serious understatement carries penalties up to 100% of the tax due and potential imprisonment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial ownership (UBO) and statutory register confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI – Beneficial Ownership Register; coordinated with the Financial Transactions and Funds Laundering Enforcement Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual consolidated confirmation submitted with the audited financial statements; individual share-transfer updates due within 30 days of each transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-disclosure or false UBO declarations are subject to fines of EGP 50,000–200,000 and director imprisonment under AML Law 80/2002; persistent register omissions may lead to GAFI strike-off action.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ordinary General Assembly (OGA) minutes and share transfer / dividend resolutions
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI for resolutions concerning share capital or membership changes; minutes retained in the statutory minute book
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: OGA must convene within 6 months after fiscal year-end; executed resolutions filed with GAFI within 30 days of approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to hold the annual meeting for two consecutive years permits GAFI to commence compulsory dissolution; unlawful resolutions render directors personally liable for resulting damages.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory auditing for every Egyptian LLC regardless of revenue, asset, or headcount; no exemption or size-based threshold exists under Companies Law 159/1981 and Investment Law 72/2017
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) – substantially aligned with IFRS; fully consolidated IFRS is permitted for EFRA-regulated or internationally reporting entities

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC must maintain an up-to-date beneficial ownership register, verifying each natural person who ultimately owns or controls 25% or more of the company. Any share transfer must be recorded in the Register of Members and declared to GAFI within 30 days. At the annual statutory audit, the compliance officer must reconfirm all UBO details, and a consolidated UBO confirmation must accompany the audited financial statements submitted to GAFI.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory tax holidays up to 5 years under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 for qualifying activities in favored sectors and Special Economic Zones; additional 0% corporate tax for small and medium taxpayers registered under Law 152 of 2021 where annual turnover stays below EGP 10 million; 100% deduction for certain R&D and IT development expenditures subject to ETA approval.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Return Form No. 1; filed electronically through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-filing portal (eservices.incometax.gov.eg).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual return with quarterly provisional tax payments
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual CIT return must be filed within four months after the close of the fiscal year; the balance of tax payable must be settled by the same deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the taxpayer entity
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact English/Arabic legal name shown on the Egyptian commercial registration and tax card; a non-resident LLC acting through a Egyptian permanent establishment must use its full foreign name plus local branch registration.
Input the 9-digit TIN issued by the ETA to the LLC or the foreign company's PE file; mandatory for electronic payroll and withholding matching.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year start and end dates
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the 12-month accounting period used in accounts; non-residents must align the Egyptian PE records with the home country year unless a separate PE accounting year is approved by the ETA.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenues from all commercial activities
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report gross worldwide revenue if tax-resident in Egypt; for non-resident LLCs report only Egyptian-source revenue, including on-line sales to Egyptian customers and sales attributable to the local PE.

Itemize ordinary and necessary costs against revenues; non-resident PEs may deduct expenses actually incurred for the Egyptian PE, including head-office cost allocations only if documented under arm's-length principles.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after loss carryforward and incentives
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute Egyptian taxable profits at 22.5%; carry forward prior tax losses for up to five years; non-resident PEs cannot claim the LLC shareholder-level tax exemption on distributed profits.
Calculate final tax at 22.5% and subtract quarterly provisional tax credits already paid; any underpayment is assessed with default interest.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 5% of the tax due for each month or part of month of delay, capped at 50% of assessed tax; late payment: 2% monthly surcharge on unpaid tax; failure to file after formal demand: additional 5% monthly penalty and administrative fine of EGP 500 to EGP 5,000; deliberate non-filing may lead to criminal prosecution.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividend distributions to non-resident shareholders; resident Egyptian corporate shareholders may apply the inter-corporate dividend exemption; individuals resident in Egypt are exempt from dividend tax on listed-company distributions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a Double Tax Agreement (DTA) reduction, the non-resident shareholder must submit a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the home-country tax authority as of the payment date, plus a beneficial ownership declaration and any required Form or annex required by ETA. The Egyptian payer must file the WHT withholding forms and obtain ETA acknowledgment of the reduced or zero applicable treaty rate before remitting the dividend; if treaty relief was not pre-approved, the difference can be reclaimed through a tax refund application to the ETA within five years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: 20% on royalties and 20% on interest paid to non-residents. Most Egyptian DTAs reduce royalty and interest rates to 10-15% when the recipient is the beneficial owner; certain regional investment-protection agreements may provide a 0% rate on qualifying institutional interest income or fees paid for software use under industrial/technological cooperation clauses.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EGP 10 million aggregate annual related-party transactions (local and cross-border) triggers mandatory Egyptian Local File and Master File preparation; an additional EGP 10 million threshold applies for intra-group services and intangibles; below the threshold, taxpayers must still file a comprehensive TP disclosure with the annual CIT return.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not have a Gulf-style standalone ESR code, but substance requirements are embedded in the Income Tax Law, PE definition, CFC rules, and DTA beneficial-ownership clauses. The ETA requires actual employees, office facilities, core income-generating activity, and board decisions in Egypt; LLCs relying on tax incentives in the Suez Canal Economic Zone or other special zones must demonstrate continuous physical presence and qualified zone staff to preserve their 0% or reduced tax rates.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understating of SaaS sales revenue, use of forged invoices, concealing Stripe/Paddle payment accounts, or systematically creating false deductions in the CIT return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty equal to 30%-100% of the tax evaded, a fine from EGP 20,000 to EGP 100,000, and imprisonment for a term of 3 to 7 years under Law 91 of 2005 as amended by Law 173 of 2021.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed or directed false filings become jointly and severally liable for the full corporate tax debt plus penalties; courts routinely order personal asset freezes, travel bans, and imprisonment of the CEO/financial director.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Forming a shell Egyptian LLC without office, employees, or real commercial risk solely to redirect profits and claim treaty benefits from payments made to a foreign parent or to access special-zone tax holidays.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ETA denials of treaty relief, reclassification of assessed income as Egyptian-source, retroactive disqualification of tax holiday, imposition of 100% underpaid-tax liability, and a fine of up to EGP 2 million for abuse of incorporation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil will be pierced for shareholders and directors who organized the artificial entity; personal assets can be seized to settle unpaid tax; individuals involved in abusive cross-border transactions may face criminal prosecution and travel restrictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling software subscriptions, royalty-like IP, or support services to related parties above the EGP 10 million threshold without arm's-length benchmarking, without Local/Master File, or without submitting the ETA TP disclosure; using intercompany invoices that lack economic justification.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fixed penalty of 2%-10% of the intercompany transaction value; adjustment of taxable income upward plus 2% monthly default interest; separate fine of EGP 50,000 to EGP 5 million for missing documentation, and exclusion of the undocumented expense from deduction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for the TP penalty where non-compliance results from willful misconduct or gross negligence; the ETA may treat the absence of contemporaneous documentation as evidence of bad faith, exposing directors to refund denial, asset attachment, and criminal negligence charges.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the LLC as an unlicensed payment intermediary through Stripe/Paddle without verifying ultimate beneficial owners (UBO), failing to maintain UBO documentation, or allowing the payment rails to process funds for undisclosed third parties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Egypt AML Law No. 80 of 2002 and its executive regulations: fines from EGP 50,000 to EGP 10 million, cancellation of commercial registration, and imprisonment up to 15 years for the responsible manager if the LLC facilities money laundering; entities are also subject to administrative debarment from payment processors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners are prosecutable in their personal capacity; banks and digital payment processors are mandated to report suspicious transactions, and once implicated, directors lose the shield of the corporate entity, may be placed on a travel ban, and can be sentenced to prison with asset confiscation.
